<!--
The abstract and the impact statement written as sections of the document
rather than as yaml fields, which abstractsection.lua allows.

A successful run produces, in every format:

  - the abstract on the title page, both paragraphs of it, under a heading
    apaquarto writes itself;
  - the impact statement under its own heading;
  - neither section left in the body, so no sentence of either appears twice;
  - the article's own first section still in the body.

The abstract has two paragraphs on purpose. An abstract written in the yaml
arrives as line blocks and one written here arrives as ordinary paragraphs,
and frontmatter.lua used to read only the first of those shapes, so a
two-paragraph section abstract came out empty.
-->

# Abstract

The first paragraph of an abstract that was written in the document.

The second paragraph, which is here to show that both of them arrive.

# Impact Statement

A statement of the impact, written in the document beside the abstract.

# Introduction

The body of the article starts here, after both sections have been taken out
of it.
